text:
Ava (CSM): Hey team — CobaltMed requested a 90-min enablement block next week to finish their dedicated migration and go over post-migration runbooks. They want hands-on office hours + an agenda. Looking for slot prefs and owners.
Ravi (Solutions Eng): I can lead the migration walkthrough and live demo of the KV-cache warmup. Prefer Tue or Wed morning.
Marcus (Account Exec): Renewal check: account shows usage dip last 2 weeks, flagged as medium-risk. Include a section on quick wins to restore confidence. I can cover commercial Qs for 10 mins.
Elena (Support): I'll take the troubleshooting Q&A and escalation process. Can do Wed afternoon too.
Jess (Enablement): Suggest agenda: intro (5), migration demo (30), hands-on lab (30), runbooks + support (15), Q&A (10). Also propose a short post-session survey link to capture feedback and blockers.
Ava (CSM): thanks — propose Wed 10:00-11:30 PT or Thu 09:00-10:30 PT. Which works? Also need someone to run the lab environment and the participant invite list (client engineers + SRE lead).
Ravi (Solutions Eng): Wed 10:00 PT works for me. I'll preseed a small repo and bring a failing scenario for them to fix.
Marcus (Account Exec): Wed is fine. I'll do the 10-min renewal quick wins section.
Elena (Support): I'll set up a short troubleshooting deck and paste a couple of common logs.
Jess (Enablement): I'll create the calendar invite and include a short prep doc. Pulling in the survey: https://forms.gle/example-survey (draft).
ops-bot: Meeting created — "CobaltMed: Migration + Office Hours" Wed 2026-04-01 10:00 PT — calendar link: https://cal.company/meet/abcd1234
Ava (CSM): Agenda draft in thread below — please add 1-line bullet items you intend to cover.
Ravi (Solutions Eng): Demo steps: 1) warm KV cache 2) split-batch tuning 3) failure recovery snippet.
Elena (Support): Logs to bring: `503 on fetch`, `OOM trace`, and runbook link: https://internal.playbooks/cobaltmed-runbook
Marcus (Account Exec): Quick wins bullets: re-route low-priority traffic to general-purpose pool, enable prefix caching, commit to a 30-day performance report.
Jess (Enablement): Will include a 15-min hands-on lab where CobaltMed engineers push a small change and observe latency improvements. Need a volunteer to watch terminals.
Ava (CSM): @Ravi can you watch the lab? @Elena monitor support channel?
Ravi (Solutions Eng): Yup I got the terminal side.
Elena (Support): I'll standby in #cobaltmed-support.
Ava (CSM): Cool — last item: capture feedback and renewal risk indicators. After the session we'll run the survey + a short NPS-style check and schedule a follow-up health sync in two weeks. Marcus will own renewal touchpoint.
Marcus (Account Exec): Got it. I'll prepare a one-pager of cost/latency impact and renewal timeline options.
Jess (Enablement): I'll draft the feedback form and an automated follow-up cadence: survey at T+1 day, usage check at T+7, health sync at T+14.
Ava (CSM): Perfect. Rapid checklist: 1) Calendar + prep doc (Jess) 2) Demo + lab (Ravi) 3) Support deck + runbooks (Elena) 4) Renewal one-pager (Marcus) 5) Post-session survey (Jess) — can everyone add a quick confirm emoji when done? :thumbsup: 
Ravi (Solutions Eng): :thumbsup:
Elena (Support): :thumbsup:
Marcus (Account Exec): :thumbsup:
Jess (Enablement): :thumbsup:
Ava (CSM): Thanks — I'll send the client invite and include the prep doc. Marking as done here.
(2 days later) Ava (CSM): Post-session notes: session had 8 client engineers, lab completed successfully, survey results: 4.2/5 avg satisfaction, main blocker still around CI gating on their side. Renewal risk moved from medium -> low pending usage uptick. Adding follow-up health sync on 2026-04-15.
Marcus (Account Exec): Nice — sharing the one-pager now in DM.
Ravi (Solutions Eng): client asked for a short automation script for cache warmup — I'll upload to the repo by EOD.
Elena (Support): Logging an escalation for the CI gating item and creating a small troubleshooting playbook.
Jess (Enablement): Closing the enablement ticket and attaching slides + survey summary to the customer folder.
Ava (CSM): Great work team. Closing thread.
